settings.title: WHY I BUILT THIS
settings.paragraph_1: In 2023, I started Retaur because I was tired of paying ₦100k+ for imported protein that often turned out to be fake.
settings.paragraph_2: I wanted to make quality nutrition affordable for Nigerians.
settings.paragraph_3: But I quickly noticed a bigger problem.
settings.paragraph_4: Guys were buying our protein, using it for a few weeks, and quitting because they didn't see results.
settings.quote_1:
They weren't failing because of the product.
They were failing because of the strategy.
settings.paragraph_5: They were following influencers/trainers with a different body type and genetics from them and hoping it works for them.
settings.highlight_text: I realized selling supplements without coaching is like selling running shoes without teaching someone how to run.
settings.paragraph_6: That's why this program exists. We combined our local products (like our Whey and Protein Yogurt) with the missing piece: Guidance.
